sources.summary: Maggie and Negan renew bitter rivalries as Dead City returns for a third series. Plus: the Lycett Arms is open for merriment and mayhem. Here’s what to watch this evening 9pm, Sky One The spin-off from the zombie franchise that refuses to die is back for a third series – and immediately gets back to what it does best: kicking infected ass in apocalyptic New York. Bitter enemies Maggie (Lauren Cohan) and Negan (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) are at the point where Negan is literally about to stab Maggie in the back – but an interruption brings a change in events … Hollie Richardson Continue reading...
